pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Spatial area is larger on the upper flank and becomes smaller and more fragmented toward the lower shoulder. Interior patch pigmentation shows centralized darkening specifically along the dorsal ridge.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting network of light-colored pelage forming thick, continuous pathways. Junction nodes primarily display trifurcated and quadrifurcated intersections. Pixel thickness is relatively consistent across the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck. The mane consists of dark, short, dense hair fibers creating a jagged 1D geometric contour against the sky background.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical skin fold or muscular indentation is visible at the transition point between the lower neck and the shoulder/brisket area.
